# GOMAX Ultimate

> GOMAX Ultimate is a pay-once, self-hosted, AI-native operating system for WordPress and WooCommerce. Users connect ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini and run their entire website by chatting — building pages, generating and optimizing images, fixing SEO/GEO, publishing content, managing their shop, and capturing leads — with no subscription and with their data staying on their own site (bring-your-own-AI-key).

## Key facts

- **Model:** Pay once, no subscription. Includes 12 months of updates; optional small yearly renewal afterward.
- **Privacy:** Self-hosted. First-party. Your data never routes through a third-party SaaS. Bring your own AI key (OpenAI / Anthropic / others).
- **Works with:** ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini (and other assistants) — connect the one you already use.
- **Platform:** WordPress + WooCommerce.
- **Maker:** Unlimited Possibilities.

## What it does

- Run a WordPress/WooCommerce site through natural-language chat with an AI assistant.
- Generate premium, on-brand pages from a single prompt (layout, motion, imagery).
- Create AI images and automatically serve them as fast WebP/AVIF.
- Improve SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) so the site is found on Google and recommended inside AI assistant answers.
- Keep a WooCommerce store discoverable and shoppable, including by AI shopping agents.
- Auto-publish SEO-ready articles on a schedule.
- Run built-in scheduled agents (SEO/GEO, Shop, Growth) that make only reversible changes with rollback.
- Provide first-party, privacy-first analytics and lead capture.
